# xcb

> xcb (Excalibur) is a local, terminal-first workspace for coding agents. Bring accounts, choose models, and shape the interface with composable panes and extensions.

The native Rust interface is a source preview, not yet a daily-driver replacement. Claude is an execution candidate on macOS and Linux. Native Codex 0.155.0-alpha.2.6 and Devin 3000.10.31 are macOS candidates; authenticated live acceptance is pending. The TypeScript compatibility CLI's Codex and Devin task routes remain unqualified and disabled. Native setup uses supervised Codex sign-in or explicit credential imports. The file broker supports reads, writes, directory creation, and revision-checked removal and renaming of regular files; it cannot run shell commands, tests, builds, or Git. No native xcb binary or @hraness/xcb npm package is published; v0.3.0 is the legacy AgentMixer release. No cloud synchronization or required daemon is part of the native design.

## Pages

- [xcb](https://xcb.dev/): product direction, local boundaries, panes, accounts, and model modes.
- [xcb documentation](https://xcb.dev/docs): native source installation, provider readiness, current limits, and links to the compatibility reference.
- [Sitemap](https://xcb.dev/sitemap.xml): indexable HTML pages.
